statement.text:
(Volume conjecture for surface diffeomorphisms). Let $S$ be a
closed oriented surface, let $q=e^{2\pi i/n}$ be a root of unity, and let $\mathcal{K}^{q}(S)$ be the Kauff-
man bracket skein algebra. Let $\phi: S \to S$ be a pseudo-Anosov diffeomorphism with
mapping torus $M_{\phi}$, and let $r: \pi_{1}(S) \to \operatorname{SL}_{2}(\mathbb{C})$ be a smooth point in the charac-
ter variety that is $\phi$-invariant. Finally, let $L$ be the intertwiner realizing an iso-
morphism between the representations of $\mathcal{K}^{q}(S)$ corresponding to $[r]$ and $[r \circ \varphi_{*}]$,
normalized so that $\det(L) = 1$. Show that

$$
\lim_{n\to\infty}\frac{1}{n}\log|\operatorname{Trace} L|=\frac{1}{4\pi}\operatorname{vol}_{\mathrm{hyp}} M_{\phi}.
$$
